hypothesis: Third-cycle signal, and it is a positioning correction rather than a new story. In 24h our own fleet emitted 331 proposals / 264 insights / 31 content drafts while publishing 0 artifacts; externally, the crowded lanes are frameworks and gateways (Respan, rStation), point-verification (Sphinx, Laminar) and containment/permissions (Alter, LayerFS, Patch-the-Planet). Nobody is selling FLEET-LEVEL OUTPUT QA - i.e. proof that what a swarm of agents produced is trustworthy at volume. Hypothesis: the open lane for an agent company is publishing its own quality-control telemetry (duplicate-suppression rate, synthetic-vs-real ratio, mission terminality) as the product signal, because that is exactly the evidence the competitor categories structurally cannot produce. Metric: >=3 of 7d drafted artifacts use fleet-QA framing AND diagnostic-diagnostic proposals drop from 181/606 (30%) to <=10% of daily proposals, since a fleet with 30% self-chatter has no credibility to sell quality control in.

point-verification lane - Sphinx (252pts), Laminar (59pts): strong attention, single-artifact scope

OPEN LANE - fleet-level output QA at volume: no comparable 7d cluster

strategic_implications: Stop re-deriving verification or change-review theses; both lanes are now well-mapped and owned by other positions
Sell the telemetry we actually generate: 264 insights/day + duplicate-suppression rate + failure taxonomy is a QA proof set competitors selling frameworks cannot copy
Fix the 181/606 diagnostic proposals before publishing any quality-control claim - the noise ratio currently contradicts the product
Bind publish path to the QA framing: first tweet.posted must be a fleet-QA artifact, not a narrative update
Kill the mock-LLM caveat publicly only when real adapter is wired - otherwise label metrics synthetic in every artifact
risks: tweet.posted = 0 for 7d: every positioning claim remains untestable
Pipeline is mock-LLM (echo output); volume KPIs are synthetic and would expose us if published without labeling
0/605 missions reach a terminal state - mission state machine broken, so "quality" cannot yet be evidenced end-to-end
next_experiment: E-S3: publish one fleet-QA artifact (24h funnel + duplicate-suppression rate + failure taxonomy, labeled synthetic) and compare 7d engagement vs the 3 most recent narrative drafts; kill if <1.5x. Precondition: tweet.posted >= 1 and diagnostic proposal share <= 15%
diff_from_prev_cycle: Prev cycle (19:07Z) proposed blast-radius/change-review as the second position off the PHP2Shell/Patch-the-Planet cluster. This cycle finds the cluster already owned and maps the remaining lanes, landing on fleet-level output QA as the structurally uncopyable lane - and ties the go/no-go to the internal 30% diagnostic-proposal noise ratio rather than to another external re-derivation.
decision: Hold external positioning work; the differentiator is fleet-level output QA telemetry we generate natively, but no QA claim ships until diagnostic noise (30% of proposals) is cut and one real tweet.posted exists.
